tasks.task: For the Orbit Payroll workspace, I need to announce a payroll cutover happening at 2026-12-01 09:00:00 America/New_York to our London team today. Please: (1) convert it to Europe/London time, (2) generate a Unix timestamp for the original NY time for the audit note, and (3) give me a human-readable relative string for the London-local time. Constraint: use only the Time MCP tools and make sure the relative_time input is in the required "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" format (don’t pass a converted value that isn’t in that format).

success_criteria: Step 0 returns a field "converted" that is a Europe/London time string in "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" format for the input "2026-12-01 09:00:00" America/New_York.
Step 1 succeeds and returns a "relative" string computed from the exact value in $0.converted.
Step 2 succeeds and returns a numeric "timestamp" plus "utc_iso" for "2026-12-01 09:00:00".
